headline-1-m.comment:
H1 is used as the beginning top-level heading of the page content.

The h1 element should be visible graphically and to assistive technologies. It should not be hidden using CSS techniques.

headline-2-m.comment:
Defines the second-level headings of the page content.

H2 is used for the top-level sections of content on a page.

headline-2-accent-m.comment: Not to be used as primary H2 style. Emphasis accent for H2 only.

headline-3-m.comment:
Used as the third-level headings of the page content.

H3 is used for the sub-level content within the sections of content on a page.

headlne-4-m.comment:
Used as the fourth-level headings of the page content.

H4 is used for the sub-level content within the sub-sections of content on a page.

nav-drawer-selected.comment: Used for selected nav drawer links.

links-sm-selected.comment: Used for selected small text links.

body.comment: Standard Body style for web and general product body copy.

body-bold.comment: Standard Body style for emphasis of small sections of body copy.

body-paragraph.comment: Use a paragraph style for longer text sections.

article-references.comment: Used for quick read and article reference text.

caption-selected.comment: Used generically for selected caption text.

body-sm.comment: Used to display data points and smaller body text.

body-sm-bold.comment: Used to display bold data points or small body text.

list-item.comment: Bulleted lists are used when items should be grouped together but have no inherent order. When using a bulleted list, it is recommended that the text for each bullet is not longer than two sentences.

value.comment: Used to display policy number and other large values.

label-caps.comment: Used sometimes as a subtle option for a section header.

label-md.comment: Used for things like the text inside components. Tablet.

field-label.comment: Used as the label for data and content fields.

field-label-caps.comment: Used sometimes as a subtle option for a component heading.

subtitle.comment: Use as a single line used alone or in a combination with a section or component headline.

subtitle-alt.comment: Use as a single line used alone or in a combination with a section or component headline.
